description: Land Acquisition - South bar, Mannar D/S Division, Mannar District - Olaithoduvai, Mannar D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders (Nos. 121 and 122 of 2023) directing the acquisition of particular land parcels in Mannar District, including detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando) exercising powers, the core content focuses exclusively on land acquisition procedures and property descriptions, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
